t: The Magnusson Tool Bag Set provides robust and practical tool storage for professional tradespeople and DIY enthusiasts. This durable two-piece set, comprising 12-inch and 16-inch bags, is ideal for organising and transporting essential hand tools and small power tools to and from various job sites or workshops. Constructed from hard-wearing polyester with a protective plastic base and rubber feet to help protect contents from damp ground, these work bags feature comfortable padded grip handles and a dual zipped opening for secure access. External and internal pockets offer systematic organisation, while the reinforced design ensures longevity for daily trade use, with the larger bag supporting up to 10kg, and the smaller bag supporting up to 5kg.
